ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black) pixel distribution with approximately 12-15% coverage of high-intensity (white) pixels, resulting in high macro-level contrast.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dispersed high-contrast white circular rings and solid spots distributed across the central dark fields. Concentrated high-intensity white patches are mapped along the trailing edge margins and distal tips, with a distinct vertical white band at the lower left proximal quadrant.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Clearly defined V-shaped notch with an approximate interior angle of 110-120 degrees and significant bounding-box depth relative to the fluke span.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Highly irregular and jagged trailing edge topography; high-frequency serrations with pixel-amplitude variations of approximately 5-12 pixels visible along the entire visible margin from notch to tip.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Pronounced convex curvature fitted to the posterior margins of both lobes, sweeping upward toward tapered distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-density spatial detection of circular white rings and solid circular high-contrast pixel clusters (barnacle scars) distributed across the dark pigmentation of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Faint, unaligned linear white pixel disruptions (rake-like scratches) are detectable on the inner medial surface of the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive irregular fringe-like erosion and notch-like material loss along the trailing edge margins; multiple depigmented circular lesions corresponding to former parasitic/epibiotic attachment sites.
